A failed or blocked AC-01 through AC-04 PoC retains evidence and stops downstream implementation; the T003 green build remains the safe residual state.

acceptance: Hello/ReadTabs/SelectTab/Invalidate/Cancel/Result enforce protocolVersion, WorkerEpoch, requestId, decimal-string U64/PID limits, MaxFrameBytes, and ProtocolError disconnects.
The broker owns a random pipe and hidden child worker, checks its PID, and invalidates epochs/tokens on restart.

UIA runs on one windowless MTA thread; breadth-first traversal begins from HWND, excludes Document descendants, and returns Incomplete without partial tabs at every specified traversal/title/tab limit.
Select verifies epoch, WindowKey, SnapshotId, token, RuntimeId, strip membership, supported pattern, and post-select state; it never rebinds by title or position.
Stopping after T003 leaves a buildable solution and passing ProtocolAndUiaProbe tests; terminate test Workers and dispose named pipes before handoff.

acceptance: Read/select enforce deadlines before work, stop/recreate hung workers, and invalidate epoch/cache/token state.
Epoch, requestId, generation, deadline, and popup-generation mismatches are discarded without reopening a popup or overwriting a current error.
Cache obeys CacheWindowLimit/CacheTtl; stale display is non-selectable until a fresh snapshot confirms it.

CacheWindowLimit and CacheTtl boundaries are covered at T-1/T/T+1; only an open popup refreshes, latest hover reads replace old ones, Select has priority, and Cancel affects only unstarted reads/UI application.

acceptance: Idle/Waiting/Open/Closing uses a monotonic clock and matching WindowKey, hover generation, and pointer state; it observes every HoverDelay/PopupCloseGrace boundary.
